title: DEEP. ECLIPSE.
metaDescription: A 5.38-carat Fancy Deep Brownish Yellow cushion brilliant — three-stone with half-moon sides. By Bez Ambar, Los Angeles.
copy: Fancy Deep Brownish Yellow — fewer than one in ten thousand diamonds carry a saturation this deep. A five-carat cushion brilliant, cut to catch light across the full width of the table. The brownish undertone gives the yellow a slower, resined quality that behaves like amber under lamp light. The cushion cut chosen for exactly this class of stone: rounded corners, brilliant facets, every facet returning pigment.

specs.label: Gem Stones
specs.body: Center: 5.38 carats · Cushion brilliant · Fancy Deep Brownish Yellow · SI1 · 11.35 × 9.74 × 6.32 mm. Sides: two half-moon diamonds, 1.25 carats total.

specs.label: Metal
specs.body: Available in 18K white gold, yellow gold, or rose gold. Also in platinum.

specs.label: Setting
specs.body: Three-stone · cushion centre forward, two half-moon sides cut to hug the curve of the cushion, warm yellow bordered by clear white on both flanks. Detail available on inquiry.

specs.label: More Details
specs.body: GIA-graded fancy colour, cushion brilliant cut chosen for colour return. Certificate available on request. Designed and made in Los Angeles.
